guaranteed_seasons is inclusive. option_years are not guaranteed.

status is signed, option_exercised when an option covering a guaranteed season was exercised, or unconfirmed when the club has not confirmed the deal. An unconfirmed row is kept here and does not change a list or a page.
source_url and unconfirmed stay in this file and are not shown on the site.
No salary figures. A player with no row is left unchanged.
